crossRefs.note: You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain…
You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop.
Yahweh, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.
Are there any among the vanities of the nations that can cause rain? Or can the sky give showers? Aren’t you he, Yahweh…
“Be glad then, you children of Zion, and rejoice in Yahweh, your God; for he gives you the early rain in just measure…
“I also have withheld the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest; and I caused it to rain on…
lightning and hail, snow and clouds; stormy wind, fulfilling his word;
Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain, and it didn’t rain on the…
He prayed again, and the sky gave rain, and the earth produced its fruit.
These have the power to shut up the sky, that it may not rain during the days of their prophecy. They have power over…

translations.web: It is turned around by his guidance, that they may do whatever he commands them on the surface of the habitable world,
translations.bsb: They swirl about, whirling at His direction, accomplishing all that He commands over the face of all the earth.
translations.kjv: And it is turned round about by his counsels: that they may do whatsoever he commandeth them upon the face of the world in the earth.
translations.asv: And it is turned round about by his guidance, That they may do whatsoever he commandeth them Upon the face of the habitable world,
